g.text: PX4: four execution loops, one sensor-to-estimator trace

text.tspan: NuttX flat build · SENS_IMU_MODE=1 · one SPI IMU + one UART GNSS · PX4 b798249a
Five lifelines below: IRQ / OS services are NOT a fifth processing thread.
TEAL: topic publication + later consumer read; callback scheduling is stated in the label. ORANGE: wake only. GREY: OS I/O.
A reads SPI FIFO via NuttX, then publishes sensor_accel / sensor_gyro. B runs VehicleIMU, then later EKF2.
setIMUData() propagates output; the main EKF step waits for downsampled IMU readiness.
GNSS ingestion and fusion remain in EKF2's context. uORB and the output predictor have NO independent thread here.
A–C: wait → dequeue → Run() → repeat. C = wq:nav_and_controllers. Other firmware loops and backup timers are omitted.

g.text: IMU — causal handoffs, not a wall-clock timing guarantee
GNSS — independent arrival; not required to occur after the IMU example
5 UART RX buffer → read/poll wakes GPS task
